body.name: Certificate-independent physical input and source interface \(\mathsf X_{\mathrm{phys}}\)
body.construction: The structural string \(x_{\mathrm{str}}\) self-delimits the vertex and domain tables; the directed and bidirected edges of \(G^{+}\); every action type, endpoint, affected-child list, allowed-value list, precedence edge, conflict edge, ownership endpoint, and binary-rational cost in \((\mathcal A,c)\); and the unnested query \(Q\), transformed ancestry, ordered factors \(C\), and canonical literal table \(\mathrm{LIT}\). Independently of every certificate, the instance supplies oracle access to \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\). A query is exactly an \(|\mathcal A|\)-bit protocol mask \(S\). The answer is either \(\bot\), or an immutable symbolic handle \(h_S\) for the complete acquired law followed by a self-delimiting support bit table indexed lexicographically by the Cartesian product of the catalogued allowed-value lists of the RAND and CTF-RAND actions in \(S\) and the encoded domains of the READ endpoints in \(S\); its exact payload is one bit per element of that product plus the handle and index headers. The table therefore decides the support of every admissible event and every READ cell exactly; CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) manipulates \(h_S\) symbolically and never evaluates a hidden law. One execution is charged \(N_{\mathcal O}\), the total bits in its oracle queries and replies, and may cache one reply per distinct protocol. The finite structural length is \(N_{\mathrm{in}}=|x_{\mathrm{str}}|\). No protocol choice, slice label, source mask, factor-ownership choice, transcript, oracle reply, or source-law value occurs in \(x_{\mathrm{str}}\).
